title: Chosen People

questions.question: How many nations greater than Israel would God cast out?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:1 (ESV): "...seven nations more numerous and mightier than you..."

questions.question: Why did God choose Israel?
options: Because He loved them and kept His oath
Because they were the largest nation
questions.correctAnswer: Because He loved them and kept His oath
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:7–8 (ESV): "It was not because you were more in number... but it is because the LORD loves you and is keeping the oath..."

questions.question: What were they to do with the images of foreign gods?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:5 (ESV): "...break down their altars... and burn their carved images with fire."

questions.question: What should Israel not do with the inhabitants of the land?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:2–3 (ESV): "Make no covenant with them... You shall not intermarry with them..."

questions.question: Who is the faithful God who keeps covenant to a thousand generations?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:9 (ESV): "Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant... to a thousand generations..."

questions.question: If they keep the commandments, what will God take away?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:15 (ESV): "And the Lord will take away from you all sickness, and none of the evil diseases of Egypt..."

questions.question: How should they destroy the nations?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:22 (ESV): "The Lord your God will clear away these nations before you little by little."

questions.question: Why not destroy them all at once?
options: Lest the wild beasts grow too numerous
questions.correctAnswer: Lest the wild beasts grow too numerous
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:22 (ESV): "You may not make an end of them at once, lest the wild beasts grow too numerous for you."

questions.question: Why should they not covet the silver or gold on the idols?
options: Lest you be ensnared by it
questions.correctAnswer: Lest you be ensnared by it
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:25 (ESV): "You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them... lest you be ensnared by it, for it is an abomination..."

questions.question: Who will God send against the nations to throw them into confusion?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:20 (ESV): "Moreover, the Lord your God will send hornets among them, until those who are left and hide themselves... are destroyed."

questions.question: What is the status of Israel specifically mentioned in verse 6?
options: A people holy to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: A people holy to the Lord
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:6 (ESV): "For you are a people holy to the Lord your God."

questions.question: What happens to those who hate God?
options: He repays them to their face by destroying them
questions.correctAnswer: He repays them to their face by destroying them
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:10 (ESV): "...and repays to their face those who hate him, by destroying them."

questions.question: What specifically should be cut down (or hewn down)?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:5 (ESV): "...smash their pillars and hew down their Asherim..."

questions.question: Bringing an abominable thing into your house makes you what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:26 (ESV): "And you shall not bring an abominable thing into your house and become devoted to destruction like it."

questions.question: Regarding reproduction, what blessing is promised?
options: There shall not be male or female barren among you or your livestock
questions.correctAnswer: There shall not be male or female barren among you or your livestock
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:14 (ESV): "There shall not be male or female barren among you or among your livestock."

key_verse_text: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and steadfast love with those who love him and keep his commandments, to a thousand generations. (ESV)
